# AI FlowPal

AI FlowPal builds custom customer-work AI tools that help service teams stay ahead of requests, follow-up, status updates, reminders, reporting, and reviewed next steps. The service starts by mapping how each business actually works - customers, tools, team rules, review steps, and promises - then uses AI to organize information, prepare summaries, reminders, drafts, routing, notes, and review lists while the team stays in control.

Website: https://aiflowpal.com/
Contact: hello@aiflowpal.com

Key pages:
- https://aiflowpal.com/ - customer-work AI tools for real business processes
- https://aiflowpal.com/about/ - company profile and entity page for AI FlowPal custom AI workflow tools
- https://aiflowpal.com/ai-workflow-automation-for-small-business/ - small business workflow fit repair
- https://aiflowpal.com/customer-follow-up-automation/ - customer follow-up workflow repair

- https://aiflowpal.com/immigration-consultant-ai-workflow/ - admin workflow support for immigration consultants
- https://aiflowpal.com/travel-agency-ai-workflow/ - travel agency workflow support
- https://aiflowpal.com/real-estate-lead-follow-up-automation/ - real estate lead follow-up workflow support

Boundary: AI FlowPal focuses on workflow/admin support with team review where risk matters. It does not provide legal, immigration, medical, tax, insurance, travel, or financial advice. External/customer-facing actions and sensitive decisions should stay reviewed by the business.
